name: Trail Cap
flavor: A knotted cap every explorer ties before the first long walk.

name: Felt Hat
flavor: Pressed felt, a little stiff, and it keeps its shape in any weather.

name: Wayfarer's Hood
flavor: A deep hood for long roads, made by someone who walked a great many.

name: Kelp Cap
flavor: Woven from kelp that moves as if the tide were still in.

name: Brine Hood
flavor: A salt-stiff hood that smells of the harbour and never quite dries.

name: Tidecaller's Crown
flavor: A crown of shell and driftwood. The sea answers when it is worn.

name: Coal-Warm Cap
flavor: Kept by a forge fire until it forgot how to be cold.

name: Forge Hood
flavor: A heavy hood singed at the edges, from standing too near the anvil.

name: Emberkeeper's Crown
flavor: Iron and cinder-glass, worn by those who tend the oldest fires.

name: Acorn Cap
flavor: A real acorn cap, a size too big, and very proud of it.

name: Bark Hood
flavor: Stitched from bark strips that creak softly when the wind turns.

name: Greenwarden's Crown
flavor: A ring of living branches that was never once cut from its tree.

name: Thundercap
flavor: Crackles when you rub it on wool, and sometimes when you don't.

name: Static Hood
flavor: Its lining is copper wire, and your hair stands up when you wear it.

name: Storm Cowl
flavor: A cowl woven with lightning-struck thread. It hums before a storm.

name: Patch Scarf
flavor: Mended so often that it is mostly patches, and tougher for it.

name: Woolen Wrap
flavor: A thick wrap, knitted in the long evenings, warm to the very end.

name: Traveller's Mantle
flavor: A long mantle that has seen every road, and mended every one of them.

name: Seafoam Scarf
flavor: Light as foam, and it keeps a little pool of seawater in its folds.

name: Brine Shawl
flavor: A shawl that holds the sea in its weave and keeps the cold out.

name: Tidewarden's Mantle
flavor: A mantle for those who guard the shore, heavy with sea-salt and pride.

name: Ember Muffler
flavor: Hammered soft on a forge that was left running overnight.

name: Forge Scarf
flavor: A scarf of quenched wool, tough as a smith and just as quiet.

name: Emberkeeper's Mantle
flavor: A mantle that stays warm all night, long after the fire is out.

name: Leafknit Scarf
flavor: Soft with moss, and a small fern grows from it in spring.

name: Bark Shawl
flavor: A shawl lined with moss and bark. Soft inside, stubborn outside.

name: Greenwarden's Mantle
flavor: A mantle that grows a little each spring, and shelters whoever wears it.

name: Static Wrap
flavor: A copper thread wound through the wool taps out a rhythm.

name: Copper Wrap
flavor: A wrap threaded with copper. It taps along to your footsteps.

name: Stormcaller's Mantle
flavor: A mantle that crackles in the dry air. Thunder waits just behind it.

name: Festival Hearth Scarf
flavor: A warm scarf given to everyone who stood by the Festival hearth.

name: Trail Charm
flavor: A knotted cord every explorer ties before the first long walk.

name: Tidepool Charm
flavor: A shell that keeps a little pool of seawater in it, always.

name: Cinder Charm
flavor: A coal that stays warm in the coldest pocket.

name: Mossy Charm
flavor: Soft with moss, and a small fern grows from it in spring.

name: Static Charm
flavor: Crackles when you rub it on wool, and sometimes when you don't.

name: Crossroads Compass
flavor: Its needle points at the four roads, and sometimes at a fifth.

name: Warden's Bell
flavor: Rung once at the gate, so everyone behind it knows who stands there.

name: Hearth Bell
flavor: A small brass bell that sounds like supper being ready.

name: Footprint Charm
flavor: A clay print of a paw that was always the first one there.

name: Pounce Charm
flavor: A claw on a string, tied tight, and itching to be used.

name: Festival Lantern Charm
flavor: A paper lantern charm, lit once a season at the Festival of the tide.
